python3 - <<'PY'
import random, subprocess, os, tempfile
BIN='/work/submit/planb64'; REF='/work/tests/ref'
def brute(entries,key):
    best=(-1,-1)
    for k2,L,hop in entries:
        mask = 0 if L==0 else ((1<<L)-1)<<(64-L)
        if (key & mask) == (k2 & mask) and L>best[1]: best=(hop,L)
    return best
rnd=random.Random(99)
for round_ in range(12):
    entries=[]
    seen=set()
    for base in range(60):
        b=rnd.getrandbits(64)
        for L in range(32,65):
            k=b & ((1<<64)-1) ^ ((1<<64)-1)  # placeholder
        for L in range(32,65):
            mask=((1<<L)-1)<<(64-L)
            k=(b & mask) if L else 0
            if (k,L) in seen: continue
            seen.add((k,L)); entries.append((k,L,rnd.randrange(0,4294967296)))
    tmp=tempfile.mkdtemp()
    fib=os.path.join(tmp,'f'); img=os.path.join(tmp,'i')
    with open(fib,'w') as f:
        f.write("\n".join("%x:%x:%x:%x::/%d %d"%((k>>48)&0xffff,(k>>32)&0xffff,(k>>16)&0xffff,k&0xffff,L,h) for k,L,h in entries)+"\n")
    p=subprocess.run([BIN,'build',fib,img],capture_output=True,text=True)
    assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr
    rows=open(img).read().strip().split('\n')
    n=int(rows[1])
    body=rows[2:]
    assert len(body)==n
    for i,b in enumerate(body):
        f0,f1,f2=b.split(' ')
        k=int(f0,16); h=int(f1); l=int(f2)
        w=brute(entries,k)
        assert (h,l)==w, (i,b,w)
        if i>0:
            pk=int(body[i-1].split(' ')[0],16)
            assert brute(entries,k-1)!=(h,l), ("redundant",i,b)
    assert n<=400001
    print("round",round_,"entries",len(entries),"rows",n,"OK")
print("NESTED-HEAVY OK")
PY
